system.description:
You gain a rank of Mastery to Deception. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.

When you take the Create Diversion skill action, you may, as part of that action, make one Weapon attack against one target creature you can reach. On a successful check, you can instead make two weapon attacks.
